_note: P&C-cyclus (Planning & Control) — appended onto the bundled src/manifest.json by main.js::mergeManifestFragments (ADR-037). PCCycli index + cyclus detail (year-view timeline) + step detail pages; schema refs BY SLUG (pc-cyclus / cyclus-stap), never PascalCase. The Dashboard 'P&C-stappen over deadline' stat widget lives in the base src/manifest.json (design D6: mergePages replaces a same-id page wholesale, so a fragment cannot add one widget to Dashboard without duplicating it). The cyclus-detail year-view timeline (design D7) is one custom widget; the plain step grid on the same page is the graceful-degradation fallback.
